WITH combination_averages AS (
  SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
with_deviations AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt,
         avg_optvolrt - AVG(avg_optvolrt) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM combination_averages
),
with_type_averages AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation,
         AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviations
),
kept AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation,
         deviation - type_avg_deviation AS excess
  FROM with_type_averages
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
    AND deviation > type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;
